dataset: Colasanti/Mazza et al. RealEye crime scene, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.7194229
outer_cv: stratified 10-fold by group; 3 repeats for screening, 2 further frozen fold seeds held back

tasks.g2_vs_g3: Guilty Deceptive vs Innocent Honest (both visited the room)
tasks.g2_vs_g1: Guilty Deceptive vs Guilty Honest (published pair)

configs.base_pub36_lr_unreg: Published method: logistic regression (ridge 1e-8) on the 36 target-AOI count/duration features
configs.i1_pub36_lr: Same 36 features, L2-LR with tuned C
configs.i2_diffshare_lr: AOI share on each target minus own AOI share on neutral images (36), L2-LR

configs.i2_z_lr: target AOI value z-scored against own neutral images (36), L2-LR
configs.i3_crime_lr: desk-AOI and central-third shares per target, cross-target mean/SD, neutral-referenced (36), L2-LR
configs.i4_all_lr_none: raw + diffshare + crime (162), L2-LR, no selection
configs.i4_all_lr_anova: 162 features, ANOVA-F SelectKBest k in {5,10,20} tuned inside, L2-LR
configs.i4_all_lr_stability: 162 features, stability selection (30 L1 half-samples) then L2-LR
